summary.text: Kevin Harris is a Democratic Maryland state senator from District 27 who was appointed in December 2025 and is seeking election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A U.S. Navy veteran and defense information-technology project manager, he served in the House of Delegates from 2023 to 2025.

paragraphs.text: Kevin Harris was born in Newark, New Jersey, on October 24, 1981, and graduated from St. Benedict's Preparatory High School in 1999.
He served in the U.S. Navy from 1999 to 2009, including a posting with the White House Communications Agency.
Harris earned a B.A. in general studies from Washington Bible College in 2011 and a master's degree in leadership development from Walden University in 2014.
He has worked on Defense Information Systems Agency projects at Fort Meade and has been a deputy program manager at Technica Corporation since 2018.
Harris represented District 27A in the Maryland House of Delegates from 2023 to 2025.
Gov. Wes Moore appointed him to the state Senate on December 3, 2025, to replace Michael A. Jackson, and he assumed office on December 9, 2025.
According to the General Assembly website, he serves on the Education, Energy, and the Environment Committee.
